states: Private 12-node mock stack (PULSE_MOCK_MODE, live websocket updates) served by Vite from this branch; headless Chromium on pulse-dev through an SSH tunnel, same stack swapped between the PR 2709 code (before) and this change (after)

Pools view with an open pool after scrolling the app shell to the top: app-shell scrollTop sampled every 500 ms for 12 s. Before: 0, 0, 1008, 1111 and 1111 for the remaining 20 samples (yanked back to the open pool). After: 0 for all 24 samples. Physical Disks view and the Workloads table read 0 for all 24 samples both before and after

Storage grouped by node with an open pool, its group collapsed by the Collapse button and, separately, by a group-header click: group state sampled every 500 ms. Before: open in all 12 samples (bounced straight back). Bridge fix alone: the header-collapsed group reopened about 1.5 s later and console probes showed the expansion sync re-adding the collapsed key on a live update. After: shut in all 32 samples (16 s) for both paths
Regrouping after a collapse: node grouping with one group collapsed shows 33 of 35 pool rows; switching to type, then ungrouped, then back to node shows all 35 rows
Final pass on the rebased tree (PR 2709 merged): the scroll and collapse samples above unchanged, no page errors at either width
interactions: Click a lower pool row: inline detail opens, row header and top of the detail in view, then Escape closes it (1440x900 and 390x844)
Click a lower physical disk row on ?tab=disks: detail opens with the row header and detail top in view (both widths)
Click a lower Workloads guest row on /proxmox: detail opens in view and Escape closes it; ?resource=<guest> deep link opens the guest detail in view (both widths)
Load ?resource=ceph-rbd: the Ceph pool detail opens in view (both widths)
With ?group=node, collapse the shared group with its disclosure button, then navigate in-app to ?group=node&resource=ceph-rbd: the group reopens and the Ceph detail is in view (both widths)
Load ?group=node&summaryGroup=<last group>: the pinned header scrolls into view and is marked active (scrollTop 1189 desktop and 1103 phone, as before the change)
Hover eight Storage and Workloads rows: rows mark active with no change in window scroll listeners or style reads versus before
Known unchanged edge recorded: with a pool already open and its group collapsed, an in-app link to that same pool does not reopen the group, because focus does not change
